answer: Attention Dwell Gate: each new identity must track a lantern swinging in wind without pause for a set window before it may transact. Any identity that stalls or forks drops to the dune floor, forfeiting all standing and restarting the full dwell from zero. The per-fake cost is one sustained-attention episode—roughly the time to trace a jade thread through a knot—so mass sybil burns real operator hours.
